image_notes: Use the official runpod/worker-vllm hub (a.k.a. worker-vllm), not the bare vllm/vllm-openai image. DSI (Deep Structured Inference) traffic is text-only and JSON-shaped; worker-vllm's OpenAI compatibility gives us the chat-completions surface we need without a hand-rolled handler.
deploy_phase_notes: runpodctl serverless create / update and the real endpoint_id, image digest, FlashBoot toggle, and Grafana dashboard wiring are DEPLOY-PHASE operations and are NOT committed here. The endpoint_id_env placeholder above must be set per environment (staging, prod) by the deploy pipeline.
